raw_title: Book Review: ‘The Ballad of the Fugitive William Parker,’ by Cristin O’Keefe Aptowicz
book_title: ‘The Ballad of the Fugitive William Parker,’ by Cristin O’Keefe Aptowicz
description: A new book by Cristin O’Keefe Aptowicz recounts how violent resistance by a group of armed Black men fueled the fight over slavery.
Lois Lowry pioneered dystopian fiction for young readers. “Building 903” adds to her legacy.
